![HPHT Vs CVD Lab Grown Diamonds: Key Differences](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-ad250768aa48:4)
A **CVD lab-grown diamond** is a real diamond created in a laboratory using a method called **Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD)** , where carbon gases build up layer by layer on a tiny diamond slice.[[1]](https://www.queensmith.co.uk/diamond-guides/lab-grown-diamonds/cvd-diamonds-what-are-they)[[2]](https://www.growndiamondcorp.com/blog/cvd-diamonds-everything-you-need-to-know/)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:788996931854626796,catalogid:15431658113329158937,gpcid:1047791399375382049,mid:576462898561212130&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/how-are-lab-grown-diamonds-made/)

### How CVD Diamonds Are Made

- **Diamond Seed:** A thin slice of a pre-existing diamond goes into a sealed vacuum chamber.
- **Carbon Gas:** The chamber fills with gases rich in carbon, such as hydrogen and methane.
- **Heat and Plasma:** Extreme heat (around 1,500°F) turns the gas into glowing plasma.
- **Layering:** The gas breaks down, and pure carbon atoms stick to the seed, growing the diamond layer by layer.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/how-are-lab-grown-diamonds-made/)[[2]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)[[3]](https://www.laurenbjewelry.com/blog/an-in-depth-look-at-cvd-vs-hpht/)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:788996931854626796,catalogid:15431658113329158937,gpcid:1047791399375382049,mid:576462898561212130&ibp=oshop)

### Properties of CVD Diamonds

- **Identical Quality:** They have the exact same chemical, optical, and physical traits as natural diamonds.
- **Purity:** They often form as **Type IIa** diamonds, meaning they are chemically very pure with little to no nitrogen.
- **Real Test:** They pass standard diamond testers and look identical to earth-mined stones.[[1]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:788996931854626796,catalogid:15431658113329158937,gpcid:1047791399375382049,mid:576462898561212130&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.ourosjewels.com/blogs/resources/cvd-lab-grown-diamonds-fine-jewelry)[[4]](https://www.queensmith.co.uk/diamond-guides/lab-grown-diamonds/cvd-diamonds-what-are-they)

### CVD vs. HPHT Diamonds

- **CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition):** Grows in a lower-pressure vacuum using carbon gases and heat.
- **HPHT (High Pressure High Temperature):** Replicates deep earth conditions using massive mechanical pressure and heat.
- **Differences:** HPHT stones can sometimes contain tiny metallic bits or show slight magnetism, while CVD stones do not.[[1]](https://www.laurenbjewelry.com/blog/an-in-depth-look-at-cvd-vs-hpht/)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/how-are-lab-grown-diamonds-made/)[[3]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/B_ezLOBJcCw)

You can learn more about how these stones are produced and sourced through specialized providers like [CVD Diamond Manufacturer](https://cvddiamondinc.com/).[[1]](https://cvddiamondinc.com/)
